name: Osa
source:
Acting leader of the “Yushinkai,” an anti-government organization in the world of dreams.
Despite his dignified demeanor, his tone and choice of words are relatively gentle, yet his true intentions remain somewhat inscrutable.
He goes by the name “Yoshimune.”
